C1409.title: South Korea Sets DeFi Precedent with First DEX Rug Pull Criminal Case
C1409.summary: The Seoul Southern District Prosecutors Office in South Korea indicted five suspects in the country first criminal case targeting a decentralized-exchange rug pull, with two detained and three not detained. Three market manipulation suspects were charged with manipulating the CATFI token market on a Solana DEX and conducting a rug pull, while two others were charged with helping the principal offenders evade authorities. Figures such as 256 investors losing 900 million won should be supported by direct sources if retained.
